text.card: A red giant 4,474 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 2.49 solar masses and 17.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,061 K at its surface.
